title: Run pnpm generate:importmap to verify import map is updated
body: The import map generator requires BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN and PAYLOAD_SECRET env vars. Set these in .env and run `pnpm generate:importmap` to ensure the new LessonRelationshipCell component is properly registered in the admin import map.
rationale: The cell component uses an @/ import path alias which requires the import map to be regenerated.

title: Fix the root RelationshipProvider batch-fetch bug in @payloadcms/ui
body: The underlying bug — RelationshipProvider's loadRelationshipDocs effect not firing when RelationshipCell dispatches REQUEST — affects all Payload list views using relationship cells. This should ideally be fixed in @payloadcms/ui directly (e.g., by tracking pending IDs in a ref or changing the effect trigger). The custom cell is a workaround.
rationale: The workaround only fixes this specific collection. Other collections with relationship fields in list views may exhibit the same bug.

title: Verify the test actually catches the bug by running it against the unfixed code
body: Before merging, run the new E2E test against a build WITHOUT the fix to confirm it fails (showing 'Loading...' in the relationship cells). This proves the test is actually testing the right thing.
rationale: Without confirming the test fails on the broken code and passes on the fixed code, we don't know if the test is actually validating the fix.
